topic.source_contract: Green Belt purposes, grey-belt assessment, sustainable location and Golden Rules evidence

facts.guidance: grey-belt contribution assessment, sustainable locations, Golden Rules and openness

facts.policy: Green Belt purposes, review, development and Golden Rules
facts.guard: policy route does not remove application assessment

facts.grey_belt: previously developed land and/or other Green Belt land not strongly contributing to specified purposes, subject to exclusions
facts.guard: footnote-7 assets can exclude land from grey-belt treatment

facts.golden_rules: site-specific viability should not reduce Golden Rules contributions
facts.guard: viability and policy compliance are separate from permission
headline contribution is not a completed legal agreement

scope_guards: Green Belt and grey belt are not treated as interchangeable labels.
A nearby grey-belt assessment is not applied to the parcel without exact geometry.
Previously developed land is not automatically suitable or permitted.
Footnote-7 constraints are checked before grey-belt treatment.
Golden Rules are not treated as satisfied without current quantified and secured contributions.
A planning obligation draft is not treated as executed.
Permission is not treated as commencement or delivery.
No score or promotion is written without exact boundary, purposes, exclusions, sustainability, obligations and decision evidence.
